A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MaskMark research. Their complete main texts and appendices are readable, and equations, tables, figures, and relocated material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: V1 reports original MS-COCO watermarking evaluations, localization and multi-watermark experiments, ablations, and computational measurements in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results and adds quantitative evaluations under individual distortions in Appendix D.2.

M1.justification: The two variants, masking operations, encoder and decoder components, JND modulation, and losses remain unchanged. The new Inference section explains an existing procedure; Algorithm 1 documents the resolution scaling already used in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use MS-COCO 2014 for the same global, local, localization, and multi-watermark tasks. The individual-distortion results cover existing distortion types, and the VAE attack families remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain StegaStamp, SepMark, TrustMark, EditGuard-C/D, Robust-Wide, VINE-R, and WAM. Localization and multi-watermark comparisons retain their respective comparator sets; the new distortion analysis uses the existing WAM comparator.

E3.justification: V2 adds individual-distortion evaluations alongside the original randomly pooled evaluations. Other specified settings remain unchanged. Section 4.2 now says all 41,000 validation images are evaluated, but Appendix C.2.3 retains the original 9,600 image-mask pairs, so an actual sample-size increase is not established.

E4.justification: Appendix D.2 adds a substantial robustness breakdown across 13 distortions, examining extraction and localization of both watermarked and unwatermarked regions. Existing bit-length, visual-quality, VAE fine-tuning, and masking analyses are retained. Some qualitative tampering examples from v1 Figure 5 are removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added curves retain the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: New Figures 9–11 report extensive per-distortion results, including WAM's weakness under rotation and its localization advantage under some hue changes. Tables 1–2 and matched quantitative plots retain their values. Section 4.3 also corrects the small-unwatermarked-region localization advantage from MaskMark-D to MaskMark-ED, consistent with the unchanged Figure 4.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 retain the same mathematical content, and neither version provides theoretical propositions or proofs. The added resolution-scaling pseudocode documents an existing procedure rather than introducing new mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: Both versions claim the same watermarking capabilities, superior robustness, high visual quality, computational efficiency, message-length scalability, and fast adaptation. Rewritten summaries and removal of the contribution bullets do not materially redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Appendix A newly acknowledges visible artifacts remaining after JND modulation, particularly in smooth backgrounds, and suggests an imperceptibility–local-robustness trade-off. Appendix B expands discussion of forensic attribution and licensing applications.

D1.justification: Appendix C.2.1 adds explicit resolution-scaling pseudocode covering normalization, residual interpolation, and clipping. Most training, fine-tuning, and evaluation details are relocated from v1 rather than newly disclosed; the code-access link remains unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 30 cited works are retained, but Section 2.1 expands the critique of WAM by explaining how averaging pixelwise predictions can become unreliable for small watermarked regions. This modestly sharpens the positioning of MaskMark.

P1.justification: Extensive rewriting and reorganization consolidate the methodology under Training, add a dedicated Inference section, shorten the main experimental exposition, and redistribute details and analyses into expanded appendices. Limitations and Impact Statement sections are also added.

P2.justification: V2 redraws the training pipeline, adds inference and mask-arrangement diagrams and three multi-panel robustness figures, merges previously separate visual-example figures, and relocates several analytical plots to the appendix. These substantially change the visual organization.

improvement.justification: The individual-distortion results make robustness strengths and exceptions easier to assess. Explicit artifact limitations, resolution-scaling pseudocode, and the corrected Figure 4 discussion improve transparency and accuracy. These are bounded gains over an already extensive evaluation; the new inconsistency between Section 4.2's 41,000 images and Appendix C.2.3's 9,600 pairs weakens protocol clarity.
